purpose: Workspace secret metadata, hidden source generations carrying ciphertext, session custody heads and bindings, the revocation epoch, managed-call authorizations, the provider-credential binding directory for BYOK, and the per-workspace quota counters that bound both collections.

serverSideEncryption.rationale: A dedicated secret CMK, distinct from content and from every other table (R-SECRETS). Application-layer AEAD is the real protection; SSE is defence in depth.

stream.rationale: Disabled deliberately: no consumer role should ever be able to read secret ciphertext off a change feed, and there is no legitimate regional consumer.

timeToLive.rationale: Deletion is explicit, so TTL would only create a silent erasure path for secret material.
